title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Vinyl Crate Library. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. (Image gen unavailable this session — choosing from direction cards; build will be code-led.)

options.label: Vinyl Crate Library
options.thesis: Your places as covers you own: browse the crate, expand one, open it.
options.viewport: Shell with city scope and filters above a dense cover grid; focused cover expands while neighbors compress to spines.
options.risk: Can read as media-app costume if filters and map lose equal footing with covers.

raised.raise: Every place cover shares one fixed aspect ratio and a shared baseline across the grid.
Want vs been is encoded as distinct density marks (solid vs hatch), not soft pastel pills.
Active filters read as layered translucent sheets over the work field — density of overlay, not darkroom chrome.

options.label: City Atlas Pages
options.thesis: Each city is a plate in your atlas; near-me is the open spread.
options.viewport: Shell with city plate title; list and map share one spread; filters sit as legend keys.
options.risk: Also the direction most place-library runs land on — familiar map+list.

options.label: Guide-Map Lobes
options.thesis: City scope as a flat-colour lobe; places live on its coastline.
options.viewport: One dominant city lobe framing the work area; yellow capsules for live filters; place list rides the coast.
options.case: Strong audience ID for city/place; clarity loses when lobe art competes with filter/search as the primary job.
options.risk: Coastline motion can steal attention from finding a place fast.

options.label: Title-Card Wall
options.thesis: Rows of place covers; focus grows one tile and dims the rest.
options.viewport: Horizontal rails of place covers under status row headings; focused tile expands with name and status.
options.case: Holds browse clarity; loses audience ID — reads media shelf more than owned place library.
options.risk: Netflix muscle memory fights Immich-adjacent self-host trust.

options.label: Warm Consumer Surface
options.thesis: Comfortable cards, plain labels, one action colour only where you can press.
options.viewport: Scrolling place cards under a clear filter bar; bottom nav; accent only on Add and active filters.
options.case: Wins product clarity as a working app; loses identification — category-default comfort.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from every other soft-card PWA if the signature move stays weak.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.case: Loses both axes — gardener identity, not place ownership.
options.kept: Shared fixed-aspect plates on one baseline.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.case: Loses both axes — notation costume obscures place search.
options.kept: Precise state encoding through density marks.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.case: Loses audience ID; filter-overlay idea is strong but the darkroom reads costume.
options.kept: Layered translucent filter density over the work field.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Self-host media-library product UI: clean grid, filters, side or top nav — Immich-adjacent craft, place cards instead of photos.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar + filters + responsive place card grid; map as a toggle; no costume.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from adjacent self-host apps by design.
